mechanism: Compare a custom ordinary INSPECT subtask with native predefined <INSPECT> under one identical two-step mission preparation and one successful mission.

configuration.preparation: SEQ1 ten-minute ordinary INSPECT control versus built-in <INSPECT> child; SEQ2 twenty-minute SERVICE shared

hypotheses_to_test: The built-in <INSPECT> reference resolves directly without duplicate SubTaskType definition and converts with zero errors.
Both variants perform positive ten-minute SEQ1 then twenty-minute SEQ2, launch at 8, succeed at 10 and return ready.
Native event identities, duration, all report bins and terminal state reconcile with the exact pairwise source delta.
All populated source tables roundtrip exactly, native outputs are nonempty, raw artifacts are sealed, and GUI/mutex guards hold.
limits: This tests one mission-preparation use of <INSPECT>; other task categories, resources and inspection findings are unverified.
An ordinary custom INSPECT ID is not the same native identifier as <INSPECT>.
GUI-only behavior and cross-engine parity are unverified.
